answer: Progressive bonding resists sybils: the deposit each new identity must lock scales superlinearly with how many identities already trace to the same funding source. One agent at the zenith of a fresh funding root posts a small bond; the hundredth clone funded from that same ledge of capital posts a far steeper one, so total stake grows faster than headcount. Honest solo agents pay little while mass minting climbs a cost wall. Like yarrow spreading from one root, correlated identities are priced by shared origin. Precondition: funding provenance is traceable on-ledger.
